Theorem
Source: topping:page-0047 ↗ topping-maxpr-weak-minimum-principle 1. ch3:2.1\group maximum-principle

Let $g(t)$ be a Ricci flow on a closed manifold $\M $ for $t\in [0,T]$. If $R\geq \alpha \in \RR $ at $t=0$, then \[ R\geq \frac{\alpha }{1-\left(\frac{2\alpha }{n}\right)t} \] for all $t\in [0,T]$.

Proof

\sketch Apply the weak minimum principle to the scalar curvature evolution equation (2.5.6), with $u=R$, $X=0$, and $F(r,t)=\frac{2}{n}r^2$. Its comparison ODE has solution

\[ \phi (t)=\frac{\alpha }{1-\left(\frac{2\alpha }{n}\right)t}. \]

□
